synthesis.paragraph: In the urban data science citation graph, "Potential impacts of personal autonomous vehicles on travel behaviors" shares six references with the June 22 paper "Environmental impact analysis of shared autonomous vehicles", including studies on agent-based modeling in Lisbon, agent-based simulation in Austin, and taxi ride sharing in New York City. This same paper shares four references with the July 3 paper "Private or shared? How awareness and attitudes shape autonomous vehicle preferences in urban contexts", including works on travel and the built environment, accessibility jumps, and shared autonomous vehicle services. Additionally, "Potential impacts of personal autonomous vehicles on travel behaviors" shares four references with the July 17 paper "Autonomous universal access", including publications on Austin charging infrastructure, integrated land use models, and international modeling studies of travel behavior. Over the last 30 days, Tongji University appeared on 31 papers, Hong Kong Polytechnic University appeared on 24 papers, Peking University appeared on 20 papers, and the University of Hong Kong appeared on 19 papers.
